parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: Q-type (resistivity decreases progressively with depth: ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 > ρ4 > ρ5)
Aquifer depth: 41.32 m to 42.31 m (transitioning into a thicker saturated zone below 42.31 m)
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone beginning at 41.32 m; plan drilling to at least 50 m to fully penetrate the underlying conductive layer (10.9 ohm-m) and confirm aquifer thickness, with casing set through the overlying resistive formations (layers 1–3) to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination.
